bib.title: 8 NED with open LLMs and domain ontologies (Knowledge Graphs and LLMs in Action, ch. 8)
authors: Negro et al. (book authors not printed in the chapter text; name taken from the repo's citations)

question: How can open LLMs plus a domain ontology (SNOMED) do named entity disambiguation without the domain, update and relationship limits of tools like scispaCy?
hypothesis: Combining a general-purpose open LLM with an ontology's relational structure (shortest paths, translated and summarised) disambiguates entities better than a context-word-based linker.
contributions: End-to-end NED pipeline: LLM NER, full-text candidate selection, then candidate disambiguation by shortest paths, path-to-text translation and summarisation
Local deployment with Ollama and Llama 3.1 8B

limits: No quantitative evaluation: no accuracy, no gold labels, no comparison with scispaCy beyond one worked passage.
Results obtained in October 2024 with the latest Llama 3.1 version then; model output varies by version.
LLM struggles to give start/end character offsets, so they are computed in post-processing.
Candidate selection uses full-text search only; vector search is suggested as an enhancement but not done.
Prompts shown are simplified; full prompts are in the book's repository.
practices: Do not use the LLM for candidate selection: retrieve candidates from the ontology by full-text search because the ontology is too large for a prompt and should not rely on model memory (Sec 8.4.2).
Define NER categories from the ontology (SNOMED first-level nodes propagated through SNOMED_IS_A) and put them in the NER prompt (Sec 8.4.1).
Compute mention start/end offsets in Python after NER, since LLMs detect them poorly (Sec 8.4.1).
Restrict full-text candidate search to the labels returned by NER to shrink the search space (Sec 8.4.2).
Exclude high-degree hub nodes when detecting shortest paths so connections are specific (Sec 8.4.3).
Translate graph paths to sentences, then summarise them, to cut tokens ('cognitive load') before the final disambiguation prompt (Sec 8.4.3).
Run models locally with Ollama through its OpenAI-compatible API at temperature 0 (Sec 8.3).

terms.definition: named entity disambiguation; here three stages: NER, candidate selection (CS), candidate disambiguation (CD)
identifies relevant entities or concepts that could match the intended meaning of each identified named entity
uses contextual information from co-occurring entities, cross-referenced with the ontology, to pick the most accurate match
